items.title: Secure the handoff: A delegation audit for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: This post shows you how to find those delegation failures in 30 minutes and what to do about them. It builds on the delegation model introduced in the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore companion post and turns it into an audit you can run today. This post also shows you how to enforce the boundaries you find on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy, AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.
items.creator: Brigette Bucke
